notes: NukeToken (src/NukeToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20: name On-Chain Oppenheimer, symbol NUKE, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments, makes no external calls and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 NUKE (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory. totalSupply() is a compile-time constant: there is no mint, burn, owner, pause, blacklist, freeze, fee or burn on transfer, upgrade path, delegatecall or selfdestruct. transfer and transferFrom move exactly the amount requested for every caller, so the factory's transfer of the swarm's share to the MerkleDistributor, the single-sided seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager, distributor claims, trader swaps and the remainder to economics.remainderTo all arrive whole without any exemption. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (2,500 IMD for the whole supply) and token.totalSupply.
